mcqs.question: The Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, came into force on which date, replacing which earlier rules?
mcqs.explanation: The Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, became effective on April 1, 2026, replacing the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016. The Plastic Waste Rules, 2016, are a related but separate set of rules, while April 1, 2016 and April 1, 2022 are incorrect dates.
